channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Creek Park South Extension
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Creek Park South Extension (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension: The P8 record no longer lists the OCII December…
item.description: The P8 record no longer lists the OCII December 2019 land use map as a source, because no statement on the page relies on it. Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension: Notes on pages that could not be read are now…
item.description: Notes on pages that could not be read are now plain statements, and mapping-process detail is left to the shape's own notes. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension: Parcel P8 open space: a page cited in the summary…
item.description: Parcel P8 open space: a page cited in the summary is now marked as undated, since it shows no publication date. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension: The timeline now shows construction as expected…
item.description: The timeline now shows construction as expected to begin in 'Late 2026 / Early 2027', per Rec and Park, and no longer marks the park as under construction; no source read says work has started. The 2015 plan's '2019' is described as the estimated lease termination date for the Phase II Future Parks, not a build target. Source: Rec and Park, Mission Creek Park South Extension (sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje); Mission Bay LRPMP, Dec 2015 (sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension: P8's 2015 plan entry no longer dates the park's…
item.description: P8's 2015 plan entry no longer dates the park's schematic design to 2022; the schematic itself carries a June 2006 sheet. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25950/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Project---Schematic-P2-P8.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park South Extension: The P8 open-space record described a…
item.description: The P8 open-space record described a 'pump-station-side' portion, which implies a pump station stands there; SF Rec and Park's schematic design calls Pump Station No. 4 'proposed' and no source read says it was built, so the text now says the strip is beside the proposed pump station's site. The record also dated the Schematic Design document to February 2022; February 10, 2022 is the date of the separate CAC overview deck. The schematic is undated, names Catellus and the Redevelopment Agency and includes a plan sheet dated June 23, 2006, and the record now says so. The project manager's contact was re-read on the project page and is unchanged. Source: SF Recreation and Park, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project, Schematic Design P2-P8 (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25950/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Project---Schematic-P2-P8); SF Recreation and Park, Overview of Mission Creek Park P2-P8, Mission Bay CAC, 2022-02-10 (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25951/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Project---Overview-of-Mission-Creek-Park-P2-P8---CAC); SF Recreation and Park, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje).

item.title: Expected · Mission Creek Park South Extension: Construction expected to begin 'Late 2026 /… (~2026)
item.description: Construction expected to begin 'Late 2026 / Early 2027' for the Mission Creek Park South Extension (parcels P2 and P8), per Rec and Park's project page; a July 2025 update said construction was expected to begin in 2026 with an 18-month duration (~2026). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department; San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (News Flash), 2025-07-30.
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department; San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (News Flash), 2025-07-30

item.title: Planned · Mission Creek Park South Extension: Same Dec 2015 LRPMP lists Park P8 (APN… (Dec 2015)
item.description: Same Dec 2015 LRPMP lists Park P8 (APN 8709-003(p), between Mission Creek and Mission Bay Drive, partially under I-280) as a designated Open Space Park Parcel under the 1998 OPA – the original planned-open-space designation, distinct from the SF Rec & Park schematic design already cited on this record, which is about design progress (Dec 2015). Source: Mission Bay North and South Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan, Dec 2015.
item.source: Mission Bay North and South Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan, Dec 2015

item.title: Planned · Mission Creek Park South Extension: Successor Agency's Approved Long-Range… (Dec 2015)
item.description: Successor Agency's Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan for Mission Bay lists Park P8 ("Vacant Lot/Land") as a designated Open Space Park Parcel under the 1998 OPA, assigned to the Phase II Future Parks group (the plan gives 2019 as the estimated lease termination date for the Phase II Future Parks; the Mission Creek Park South Extension project now has its own schedule) (Dec 2015). Source: Mission Bay North and South Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan, Dec 2015.
